description: Aaron Schroeder at the University of Virginia publishes Social Data Commons primary-care accessibility scores for Virginia and the National Capital Region. Version 4.0.1 supplies two CSV files labelled 2018–2025 under CC BY 4.0. The documented methods use CMS physician locations, population and road travel times to calculate provider counts, three floating-catchment indices and travel time to the ten closest facilities. Catchments use a thirty-minute driving threshold and assign one capacity unit per provider identifier. These estimates can support health-access and facility-location simulations. Input vintages differ, and a provider count is not a measured appointment capacity. The later version 5.0.0 explicitly withdraws its boundary-standardisation change, so this earlier version is retained. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these derived scores. File contents and year-to-year consistency remain unverified.
